Grade: Grade 3
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES

Topic 3.3.2: Communicating messages

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Communicating messages. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. recognize persuasive messages on how to manage waste
2. use hand, print and electronic media to create messages on how to manage waste in the community
3. communicate messages on management of wastes in the community. created waste management messages.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. recognize persuasive messages on how to manage waste
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to recognize persuasive messages on how to manage waste. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. use hand, print and electronic media to create messages on how to manage waste in the community
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to use hand, print and electronic media to create messages on how to manage waste in the community. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. communicate messages on management of wastes in the community. created waste management messages.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to communicate messages on management of wastes in the community. created waste management messages. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At school, pick litter and put it in the bin. That cares for the environment.

Example 2: Wash your hands with soap before eating and after using the toilet.

Example 3: Name two foods you eat at home that help you grow strong.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Communicating messages.
2. Explain Communicating messages to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.

4. Show that you can: recognize persuasive messages on how to manage waste
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Communicating messages. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Communicating messages important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.
